theme: 新概念：两个词手拉手 = 复合词
stage: 小学四五年级 · 每日 2 词

base.example: I go home at five every day.

root.logic: home 是树干。复合词不用加尾巴，而是让两个词手拉手：home + work = homework。意思也常常是两个字意思合起来，很好猜。

family.example: I finish my homework before dinner.
I help Mum with the housework.
My hometown is near the sea.
The homeless dog needs a home.
family.exampleZh: 这只流浪狗需要一个家。

rule.formula: A + B = 复合词（意思合起来）
rule.tip: 复合词最好猜：home + work 家务作业、home + town 家乡。四年级学的 -less 也能用上：home + less = 没有家的。
